fields.label: Schedule
fields.description: When to run by itself. archive.org profiles kept in step pick up what changed (Manual ones: daily); folders pick up new and changed items. Hourly suits a drop folder.

fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Internet Archive
Folder or Server
Repository (OAI-PMH)
Wikisource
fields.description: Internet Archive: pick items on archive.org. Folder or Server: IA-style item folders on this computer, a NAS, or a web server. Repository: DSpace, EPrints or any OAI-PMH repository. Wikisource: scanned books transcribed on a Wikisource, with their proofread text.

fields.label: Choose By
fields.options:
Collection
Search Query
Identifier List
Metadata File
fields.description: Metadata File: build the catalogue from a file of records (an ia search or ia metadata export, a CSV, or a list of identifiers) without asking archive.org for each book: the fastest way to bring a big collection in.

fields.label: IA Collection
fields.description: The part after archive.org/details/ for a collection, e.g. ServantsOfKnowledge

fields.label: Narrow With (optional)
fields.description: IA search syntax, e.g. language:(kan OR Kannada) or date:[1900-01-01 TO 1950-12-31] or subject:vachana

fields.label: IA Search Query
fields.description: Any archive.org advanced search query, e.g. creator:(Kuvempu) AND language:kan

fields.label: Identifiers
fields.description: One IA identifier per line.

fields.label: Metadata File
fields.description: Upload the file (it may be gzip-compressed, .jsonl.gz). JSON Lines from ia search "collection:X" -f title -f creator -f date -f language -f subject -f description -f collection -f imagecount -f format, full records from ia metadata, a CSV with an identifier column, or one identifier per line.

fields.label: Or a File on the Server
fields.description: For files too big to upload: its path under the library folder, e.g. /library-source/sok-metadata.jsonl.gz.

fields.label: Folder Path or Server URL
fields.description: Folder: /library-source is the folder set as LIBRARY_DIR in .env (any sub-path works, e.g. /library-source/2026). Server: a URL like https://books.example.org/items/ whose sub-folders are IA-style items.

fields.label: Item List URL (optional)
fields.description: A text file listing item folders (one relative path per line). Use it when the server has no directory listing.

fields.label: Link to archive.org When the Item Is There
fields.description: Items already on archive.org use the Internet Archive reader and links; the rest are served from your files.

fields.label: Repository's OAI-PMH Address
fields.description: The repository's OAI-PMH base address, e.g. https://dspace.example.org/server/oai/request (DSpace 7), https://dspace.example.org/oai/request (DSpace 6), https://eprints.example.org/cgi/oai2. Check Repository shows its name and sets.

fields.label: Set (optional)
fields.description: Only this set's records (a DSpace community or collection, e.g. col_123456789_42). Empty: the whole repository.

fields.label: Identifier Prefix
fields.description: Starts the catalogue identifier of each book from this repository (e.g. kud → kud-123456789-42). Letters, digits and hyphens; keep it once books are in.

fields.label: Metadata Format
fields.description: oai_dc (simple Dublin Core) is offered by every repository; leave it unless you know the repository puts more in another Dublin Core format.

fields.label: Find Each Record's PDF
fields.description: Look on each record's web page for its PDF (repositories mark it for Google Scholar) when the record doesn't give it. The PDF's text becomes the book's page text.

fields.label: Harvested Up To
fields.description: Later runs ask only for records changed since then. Refresh Items Already in Catalogue harvests everything again.

fields.label: Wikisource Address
fields.description: The Wikisource's address, e.g. kn.wikisource.org (Kannada), sa.wikisource.org (Sanskrit), ta.wikisource.org, or wikisource.org for the multilingual one.

fields.label: Category of Index Pages
fields.description: A Wikisource category whose Index pages are the books to bring in, e.g. Category:Books. Or list Index pages below.

fields.label: Index Pages
fields.description: Index pages to bring in, one per line (Index:Name.pdf). Used with, or instead of, a category.

fields.label: Pages to Take
fields.description: Wikisource marks each page not proofread, proofread or validated. Any text takes every page that has text; Proofread those a person has checked; Validated those checked by a second person too.

fields.label: Maximum Items
fields.description: 0 = no limit. Start small (50-500) for a test.

fields.label: Fetch Full Text
fields.description: Download OCR text for full-text and in-book search.

fields.label: Catalogue First, Details Later
fields.description: Lists every matching book on the portal within minutes, from archive.org's search records (thousands of books per request, as the ia command-line tool fetches them); each book's full record and page text then follow in the background.

fields.label: Access for Its Books
fields.options:
Public
Login to read
Login to find
fields.description: Who can see books ingested by this profile. Leave empty to use the rules and default in Settings. Use “Apply Access to Its Books” to change books already ingested.

fields.label: Keep in Step with archive.org
fields.description: After the first run, check archive.org every day (or on the profile's schedule) and bring the catalogue up to date: new books come in, changed ones are updated, removed ones are unpublished. Only what changed is fetched.

fields.label: Keep in Step with archive.org
fields.description: Bring in books added to archive.org since the last check (all of them: Maximum Items applies to the first run only).

fields.label: Update Changed Books
fields.description: Refresh books whose details changed on archive.org. Books with Keep My Edits keep your corrections.

fields.label: Unpublish Removed Books
fields.description: Unpublish books taken out of the collection (or made dark) on archive.org; they come back if they return. Nothing is deleted, and if many books seem to vanish at once nothing is unpublished and managers are alerted.

fields.label: Portal Collection for It
fields.description: Keep a collection page on the portal with this archive.org collection's books, named after it, filled and kept up to date automatically.

fields.label: In Step Up To
fields.description: archive.org changes up to this time are in the catalogue. Set by each completed run.

fields.label: Matching Items on IA
fields.description: Use the Check Count button.

fields.label: Also Bring in Audio and Video
fields.description: Research Desk is about texts; tick this to take the collection's recordings (audio, video, live music) too, with a player and a transcript where archive.org has one. Needs Audio and video switched on in Settings → Features.

fields.label: Each Image Is a Photograph
fields.description: A folder of images is one book (a bundle of leaves) unless this is ticked: then every image is a photograph of its own, with its EXIF and a <name>.json beside it. Needs Photographs switched on in Settings → Features.
